'''Rianna Andomeran''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]], but also secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]]. She was part of [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters|Liandrin's group of Black sisters]].

== Appearance and Personality ==
Rianna is black haired with a white streak above her left ear. 5'4 tall, she had a coldly arrogant face.

==Strength and Abilities==
Rianna has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|27}}, [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

She has the [[Talent#Blood boiling|ability to cause someone's blood to boil]], or to make one's heart to stop, killing them. Although this Talent is closely linked with [[Healing]], her potential Healing skills are unknown.

==History==
She is from [[Kandor]]. Born in {{ne|924}}, she went to the White Tower in {{ne|940}}. She spent nine years as a novice and seven as Accepted, becoming Aes Sedai in {{ne|956}}.

==Activities==
=== Fleeing the Tower ===
When the Liandrin's group of Black sisters left the [[White Tower]], they took several ''[[ter'angreal]]'' with them. They first fled to [[Tear]], but they are followed by [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Egwene al'Vere]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]. They captured the three pursuing them,{{ref/book|3|51}} but [[Matrim Cauthon]] rescued them while he aided [[Rand al'Thor]] in taking the [[Stone of Tear]].

=== Tanchico and Amador ===
Rianna and the others then fled to [[Tanchico]], but [[Joiya Byir]] and [[Amico Nagoyin]] were captured. After arriving, they lived in a house that used to belong to a [[Darkfriend]] merchant. They then gained access to the [[Panarch]]'s [[Panarch's Palace|Palace]] and held the newly invested [[Amathera Aelfdene Casmir Lounault]] captive. Unbeknownst to them, they were followed again by Elayne and Nynaeve, who had been told where they were going by Amico. Elayne and Nynaeve freed Amathera and left as a mob gathered around the palace.

Somehow, Rianna and the rest escaped and went to [[Amador]]. There, [[Moghedien]] took over the group that Liandrin had been leading. Rianna accepted her instructions stolidly, with just a touch of relief in her eyes. Her mission was unknown.{{ref/book|5|18}}

=== The [[Last Battle]] ===
Regardless of what her task was or if it was completed, Rianna appears again at the [[Field of Merrilor]] in [[Alviarin Freidhen]]'s company. Together with Alviarin and a number of Darkfriend [[Asha'man]], she is lured into an [[Ogier]] ''[[stedding]]'' and taken captive.

She is presumed to be alive and kept in [[Stedding Sholoon|''Stedding'' Sholoon]] by [[Elder|Eldest]] [[Lindsar]].
